memories:
CREATE TABLE memories (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	context TEXT NOT NULL, 
	keywords VARCHAR[] NOT NULL, 
	tags VARCHAR[] NOT NULL, 
	importance INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	embedding VECTOR(384) NOT NULL, 
	source_repo TEXT, 
	source_files VARCHAR[], 
	source_url TEXT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	encoding_agent TEXT, 
	encoding_version TEXT, 
	agent_id TEXT, 
	agent_version TEXT, 
	agent_model TEXT, 
	is_obsolete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	obsolete_reason TEXT, 
	superseded_by INTEGER, 
	obsoleted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(superseded_by) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_memories_embedding ON memories USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
CREATE INDEX ix_memories_keywords ON memories USING gin (keywords)
CREATE INDEX ix_memories_tags ON memories USING gin (tags)
memory_links:
CREATE TABLE memory_links (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_id) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_memory_links_source_target ON memory_links (source_id, target_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_memory_links_target_source ON memory_links (target_id, source_id)
memory_project_association:
CREATE TABLE memory_project_association (
	memory_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (memory_id, project_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(memory_id) REFERENCES memories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
projects:
CREATE TABLE projects (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	project_type VARCHAR(50), 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	repo_name VARCHAR(255), 
	last_encoding_point VARCHAR(255), 
	notes TEXT, 
	source_repo TEXT, 
	source_files VARCHAR[], 
	source_url TEXT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	encoding_agent TEXT, 
	encoding_version TEXT, 
	agent_id TEXT, 
	agent_version TEXT, 
	agent_model TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
users:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	idp_metadata JSONB, 
	notes TEXT, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_external_id ON users (external_id)
